description: This file defines the TerminationReasonController class which extends an abstract Vue controller. It manages the termination reason configurations within the OrangeHRM application, including initializing the service and setting up a Vue component with properties related to termination reasons in the preRender method.

classes.name: TerminationReasonController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing termination reason configurations, rendering Vue components related to termination reasons, and interfacing with the termination reason service.
